    @Override
    @NotNull
    public List<String> getLog() {
        List<String> log = new ArrayList<>();
        if (config.isInt("log.logPos")) {
            int cLog = config.getInt("log.logPos", 1);
            for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                String msg = config.getString("log." + (((cLog + i) % 10) + 1), "");
                if (msg != null && !msg.trim().isEmpty()) {
                    log.add(msg);
                }
            }
        } else {
            log.addAll(config.getStringList("log"));
        }
        List<String> convertedList = new ArrayList<>();
        Instant now = Instant.now();
        for (String logEntry : log) {
            String[] split = logEntry.split(";");
            if (split.length >= 2) {
                Instant then = Instant.ofEpochMilli(Long.parseLong(split[0]));
                String msg = split[1];
                Object[] args = new Object[split.length - 2];
                System.arraycopy(split, 2, args, 0, args.length);
                convertedList.add(tr("\u00a79{1} \u00a77- {0}", TimeUtil.durationAsString(Duration.between(then, now)), tr(msg, args)));
            } else {
                Matcher m = OLD_LOG_PATTERN.matcher(logEntry);
                if (m.matches()) {
                    String date = m.group("date");
                    Instant parsedDate = null;
                    try {
                        parsedDate = DateFormat.getDateInstance(DateFormat.SHORT).parse(date).toInstant();
                    } catch (ParseException e) {
                        // Ignore
                    }
                    String msg = m.group("msg");
                    if (parsedDate != null) {
                        convertedList.add(tr("\u00a79{1} \u00a77- {0}", TimeUtil.durationAsString(Duration.between(parsedDate, now)), msg));
                    } else {
                        convertedList.add(logEntry);
                    }
                } else {
                    convertedList.add(logEntry);
                }
            }
        }
        return convertedList;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isParty() {
        return getMembers().size() > 1;
    }

    @Override
    @Nullable
    public Location getWarpLocation() {
        if (hasWarp()) {
            return new Location(plugin.getWorldManager().getWorld(),
                config.getInt("general.warpLocationX", 0),
                config.getInt("general.warpLocationY", 0),
                config.getInt("general.warpLocationZ", 0),
                (float) config.getDouble("general.warpYaw", 0),
                (float) config.getDouble("general.warpPitch", 0));
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public Location getIslandLocation() {
        return IslandUtil.getIslandLocation(name);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        String str = "\u00a7bIsland Info:\n";
        str += ChatColor.GRAY + "  - level: " + ChatColor.DARK_AQUA + String.format("%5.2f", getLevel()) + "\n";
        str += ChatColor.GRAY + "  - location: " + ChatColor.DARK_AQUA + name + "\n";
        str += ChatColor.GRAY + "  - biome: " + ChatColor.DARK_AQUA + getBiomeName() + "\n";
        str += ChatColor.GRAY + "  - schematic: " + ChatColor.DARK_AQUA + getSchematicName() + "\n";
        str += ChatColor.GRAY + "  - warp: " + ChatColor.DARK_AQUA + hasWarp() + "\n";
        if (hasWarp()) {
            str += ChatColor.GRAY + "     loc: " + ChatColor.DARK_AQUA + LocationUtil.asString(getWarpLocation()) + "\n";
        }
        str += ChatColor.GRAY + "  - locked: " + ChatColor.DARK_AQUA + isLocked() + "\n";
        str += ChatColor.GRAY + "  - ignore: " + ChatColor.DARK_AQUA + ignore() + "\n";
        str += ChatColor.DARK_AQUA + "Party:\n";
        str += ChatColor.GRAY + "  - leader: " + ChatColor.DARK_AQUA + getLeader() + "\n";
        str += ChatColor.GRAY + "  - members: " + ChatColor.DARK_AQUA + getMembers() + "\n";
        str += ChatColor.GRAY + "  - size: " + ChatColor.DARK_AQUA + getPartySize() + "\n";
        str += ChatColor.DARK_AQUA + "Limits:\n";
        str += ChatColor.GRAY + "  - maxParty: " + ChatColor.DARK_AQUA + getMaxPartySize() + "\n";
        str += ChatColor.GRAY + "  - animals: " + ChatColor.DARK_AQUA + getMaxAnimals() + "\n";
        str += ChatColor.GRAY + "  - monsters: " + ChatColor.DARK_AQUA + getMaxMonsters() + "\n";
        str += ChatColor.GRAY + "  - villagers: " + ChatColor.DARK_AQUA + getMaxVillagers() + "\n";
        str += ChatColor.DARK_AQUA + "Bans:\n";
        for (String ban : getBans()) {
            str += ChatColor.GRAY + "  - " + ban + "\n";
        }
        str += ChatColor.DARK_AQUA + "Log:\n";
        for (String log : getLog()) {
            str += ChatColor.GRAY + "  - " + log + "\n";
        }
        return str;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasOnlineMembers() {
        ConfigurationSection members = config.getConfigurationSection("party.members");
        if (members != null) {
            for (String uuid : members.getKeys(false)) {
                if (uuid != null) {
                    UUID id = UUIDUtil.fromString(uuid);
                    if (id != null) {
                        Player onlinePlayer = plugin.getPlayerDB().getPlayer(id);
                        if (onlinePlayer != null) {
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public List<Player> getOnlineMembers() {
        ConfigurationSection members = config.getConfigurationSection("party.members");
        List<Player> players = new ArrayList<>();
        if (members != null) {
            for (String uuid : members.getKeys(false)) {
                if (uuid != null) {
                    UUID id = UUIDUtil.fromString(uuid);
                    if (id != null) {
                        Player onlinePlayer = plugin.getPlayerDB().getPlayer(id);
                        if (onlinePlayer != null) {
                            players.add(onlinePlayer);
                        }
                    } else {
                        log.info("Island " + name + " has invalid member-section: " + uuid);
                    }
                } else {
                    log.info("Island " + name + " has invalid member-section: " + uuid);
                }
            }
        }
        return players;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean contains(Location loc) {
        return name.equalsIgnoreCase(WorldGuardHandler.getIslandNameAt(loc));
    }

    public void sendMessageToOnlineMembers(String msg) {
        String message = tr("\u00a7cSKY \u00a7f> \u00a77 {0}", msg);
        for (Player player : getOnlineMembers()) {
            player.sendMessage(message);
        }
    }

package us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.command;

import com.google.inject.Inject;
import com.google.inject.Singleton;
import dk.lockfuglsang.minecraft.command.BaseCommandExecutor;
import org.bukkit.command.Command;

import org.bukkit.entity.Player;

@Singleton
public class IslandCommand extends BaseCommandExecutor {

    @Inject
    public IslandCommand(
        @NotNull uSkyBlock plugin,
        @NotNull SkyBlockMenu menu,

        @NotNull OnlinePlayerTabCompleter onlinePlayerTabCompleter,
        @NotNull AllPlayerTabCompleter allPlayerTabCompleter,

        @NotNull AcceptRejectCommand acceptRejectCommand,
        @NotNull LeaveCommand leaveCommand,
        @NotNull KickCommand kickCommand,
        @NotNull PartyCommand partyCommand,
        @NotNull MakeLeaderCommand makeLeaderCommand,
        @NotNull SpawnCommand spawnCommand,
        @NotNull TrustCommand trustCommand,
        @NotNull MobLimitCommand mobLimitCommand,

        @NotNull LockUnlockCommand lockUnlockCommand,
        @NotNull TopCommand topCommand,
        @NotNull BiomeCommand biomeCommand,
        @NotNull GreetingCommand greetingCommand,
        @NotNull FarewellCommand farewellCommand,
        @NotNull BuyHopperLimitCommand buyHopperLimitCommand
    ) {
        super("island|is", "usb.island.create", marktr("general island command"));
        this.plugin = plugin;
        this.menu = menu;

        addFeaturePermission("usb.mod.bypasscooldowns", tr("allows user to bypass cooldowns"));
        addFeaturePermission("usb.mod.bypassprotection", tr("allows user to bypass visitor-protections"));
        addFeaturePermission("usb.mod.bypassteleport", tr("allows user to bypass teleport-delay"));
        addFeaturePermission("usb.island.signs.use", tr("allows user to use [usb] signs"));
        addFeaturePermission("usb.island.signs.place", tr("allows user to place [usb] signs"));

        addTab("island", allPlayerTabCompleter);
        addTab("player", allPlayerTabCompleter);
        addTab("oplayer", onlinePlayerTabCompleter);
        addTab("biome", biomeTabCompleter);
        addTab("member", memberTabCompleter);
        addTab("schematic", schematicTabCompleter);
        addTab("perm", permissionTabCompleter);

        add(restartCommand);
        add(logCommand);
        add(createCommand);
        add(setHomeCommand);
        add(homeCommand);
        add(setWarpCommand);
        add(warpCommand);
        add(toggleWarpCommand);
        add(banCommand);
        add(lockUnlockCommand);
        if (Settings.island_useTopTen) {
            add(topCommand);
        }
        add(biomeCommand);
        add(levelCommand);
        add(infoCommand);
        add(inviteCommand);
        add(acceptRejectCommand);
        add(leaveCommand);
        add(kickCommand);
        add(partyCommand);
        add(makeLeaderCommand);
        add(spawnCommand);
        add(trustCommand);
        add(mobLimitCommand);
        add(autoCommand);
        add(permCommand);
        add(greetingCommand);
        add(farewellCommand);
        add(buyHopperLimitCommand);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onCommand(CommandSender sender, Command command, String alias, String[] args) {
        if (!plugin.isRequirementsMet(sender, this, args)) {
            return true;
        }
        if (sender instanceof Player player) {
            if (args.length == 0) {
                player.openInventory(menu.displayIslandGUI(player));
                return true;
            }
        }
        return super.onCommand(sender, command, alias, args);
    }
}

查找 BuyHopperLimitCommand.java
在 VS Code 中搜索这个文件，把完整代码发给我。它就是漏斗购买价格增幅逻辑所在。

package us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.command.island;

import com.google.inject.Inject;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.island.IslandInfo;
import us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.player.PlayerInfo;
import us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.uSkyBlock;

import java.util.Map;

import static dk.lockfuglsang.minecraft.po.I18nUtil.marktr;
import static dk.lockfuglsang.minecraft.po.I18nUtil.tr;

public class BuyHopperLimitCommand extends RequireIslandCommand {

    @Inject
    public BuyHopperLimitCommand(uSkyBlock plugin) {
        super(plugin, "hopper", "usb.island.create", "?oper", marktr("Pay to add hopper limits."));
    }

    private int calcPrice(int curlimit) {
        int price;
        if (curlimit <= 40) price = 25 * curlimit;
        else if (curlimit >= 90) price = 10000;
        else {
            price = (int) (1000 * Math.pow(1.05, curlimit - 40));
            if (price > 10000) price = 10000;
        }
        return price;
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean doExecute(String alias, Player player, PlayerInfo pi, IslandInfo island, Map<String, Object> data, String... args) {
        us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.api.IslandInfo islandInfo = uSkyBlock.getInstance().getIslandInfo(player);
        int curlimit = islandInfo.getHopperLimit();
        if (args.length > 0 && args[0].equals("buy")) {
            int price = calcPrice(curlimit);
            uSkyBlock.getInstance().getHookManager().getEconomyHook().ifPresent((hook) -> {
                boolean success;
                String result = hook.withdrawPlayer(player, price);
                success = result == null;
                if (success) {
                    islandInfo.setHopperLimit(curlimit + 1);
                    player.sendMessage("\u00a7a\u00a7l" + tr("Buy Extra Hopper Success!"));
                    player.sendMessage("\u00a77" + tr("======================"));
                } else {
                    player.sendMessage("\u00a7c\u00a7l" + tr("Buy Extra Hopper Failed!"));
                    if (hook.getBalance(player) < price) {
                        player.sendMessage("\u00a7d" + tr("You do not have enough money!"));
                        player.sendMessage("\u00a7d" + tr("You have {0}", hook.getBalance(player)));
                    }
                    player.sendMessage("\u00a7c" + tr("{0}", result));
                }
            });
        } else {
            player.sendMessage("\u00a7b\u00a7l" + tr("Buy Extra Hopper Limit"));
            player.sendMessage("\u00a77" + tr("======================"));
        }
        player.sendMessage("\u00a7b" + tr("Current Extra Limit is {0}", islandInfo.getHopperLimit()));
        player.sendMessage("\u00a7b" + tr("Price to buy another hopper limit is {0}", calcPrice(islandInfo.getHopperLimit())));
        plugin.execCommand(player, "console:tellraw " + player.getName() + " [{\"text\":\"" + tr("click to buy hopper") + "\",\"color\":\"green\",\"clickEvent\":{\"action\":\"run_command\",\"value\":\"/is hopper buy\"}}]", false);
        return true;
    }
}
找到了！价格增幅逻辑在 calcPrice 方法中。

当前价格计算逻辑
java
private int calcPrice(int curlimit) {
    int price;
    if (curlimit <= 40) price = 25 * curlimit;          // 0-40: 线性增长，每次 +25
    else if (curlimit >= 90) price = 10000;              // 90+: 封顶 10000
    else {
        price = (int) (1000 * Math.pow(1.05, curlimit - 40));  // 40-90: 指数增长
        if (price > 10000) price = 10000;
    }
    return price;
}

统一改成线性增长：price = 100 * curlimit

改指数基数：Math.pow(1.03, curlimit - 40)（增长更慢）

修改后的 calcPrice 方法
java
    private int calcPrice(int curlimit) {
        int price;
        if (curlimit <= 1) {
            price = 25;
        } else if (curlimit <= 30) {
            price = 25 + (curlimit - 1) * 25;
        } else if (curlimit <= 70) {
            price = 25 + 29 * 25 + (curlimit - 30) * 50;
        } else if (curlimit <= 120) {
            price = 25 + 29 * 25 + 40 * 50 + (curlimit - 70) * 100;
        } else if (curlimit <= 200) {
            price = 25 + 29 * 25 + 40 * 50 + 50 * 100 + (curlimit - 120) * 150;
        } else {
            price = 25 + 29 * 25 + 40 * 50 + 50 * 100 + 80 * 150;
        }
        return price;
    }

    private int calcPrice(int curlimit) {

修改 BuyHopperLimitCommand.java 中的 calcPrice 方法，然后构建即可。

package us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.command.island;

import com.google.inject.Inject;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.island.IslandInfo;
import us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.player.PlayerInfo;
import us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.uSkyBlock;

import java.util.Map;

import static dk.lockfuglsang.minecraft.po.I18nUtil.marktr;
import static dk.lockfuglsang.minecraft.po.I18nUtil.tr;

public class BuyHopperLimitCommand extends RequireIslandCommand {

    @Inject
    public BuyHopperLimitCommand(uSkyBlock plugin) {
        super(plugin, "hopper", "usb.island.create", "?oper", marktr("Pay to add hopper limits."));
    }

    private int calcPrice(int curlimit) {
        return curlimit * 5;
    }
    
    @Override
    protected boolean doExecute(String alias, Player player, PlayerInfo pi, IslandInfo island, Map<String, Object> data, String... args) {
        us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.api.IslandInfo islandInfo = uSkyBlock.getInstance().getIslandInfo(player);
        int curlimit = islandInfo.getHopperLimit();
        if (args.length > 0 && args[0].equals("buy")) {
            int price = calcPrice(curlimit);
            uSkyBlock.getInstance().getHookManager().getEconomyHook().ifPresent((hook) -> {
                boolean success;
                String result = hook.withdrawPlayer(player, price);
                success = result == null;
                if (success) {
                    islandInfo.setHopperLimit(curlimit + 1);
                    player.sendMessage("\u00a7a\u00a7l" + tr("Buy Extra Hopper Success!"));
                    player.sendMessage("\u00a77" + tr("======================"));
                } else {
                    player.sendMessage("\u00a7c\u00a7l" + tr("Buy Extra Hopper Failed!"));
                    if (hook.getBalance(player) < price) {
                        player.sendMessage("\u00a7d" + tr("You do not have enough money!"));
                        player.sendMessage("\u00a7d" + tr("You have {0}", hook.getBalance(player)));
                    }
                    player.sendMessage("\u00a7c" + tr("{0}", result));
                }
            });
        } else {
            player.sendMessage("\u00a7b\u00a7l" + tr("Buy Extra Hopper Limit"));
            player.sendMessage("\u00a77" + tr("======================"));
        }
        player.sendMessage("\u00a7b" + tr("Current Extra Limit is {0}", islandInfo.getHopperLimit()));
        player.sendMessage("\u00a7b" + tr("Price to buy another hopper limit is {0}", calcPrice(islandInfo.getHopperLimit())));
        plugin.execCommand(player, "console:tellraw " + player.getName() + " [{\"text\":\"" + tr("click to buy hopper") + "\",\"color\":\"green\",\"clickEvent\":{\"action\":\"run_command\",\"value\":\"/is hopper buy\"}}]", false);
        return true;
    }
}
这样对吗
完全正确。calcPrice 已改为 curlimit * 5，代码结构没有任何问题。

确认无误，直接构建即可
powershell
./gradlew :uSkyBlock-Plugin:shadowJar --offline
$OutputEncoding = [Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8        这个是什么意思
这是 PowerShell 的编码设置命令。

逐部分解释
代码	含义
$OutputEncoding	PowerShell 输出到外部程序时的编码
[Console]::OutputEncoding	控制台窗口显示字符的编码
[Text.Encoding]::UTF8	设置为 UTF-8 编码
一句话总结
让 PowerShell 终端使用 UTF-8 编码，解决 Gradle 构建时中文乱码的问题。

等价于
你在终端执行：

powershell
chcp 65001
效果一样，但这个每次都要手动输。上面那行写入 $PROFILE 配置文件后就一劳永逸。

将之前的手动写入配置文件的删除
删除 PowerShell 配置文件中的 UTF-8 设置
powershell
notepad $PROFILE
在打开的文件中，找到并删除这两行：

powershell
$OutputEncoding = [Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8
chcp 65001 > $null
保存后关闭。下次打开 PowerShell 就不会自动切换 UTF-8 了。

不，是你说的java什么玩意的
删除 VS Code 的 Java 编码设置
在 VS Code 中按 Ctrl+,，搜索 terminal.integrated.env.windows，点击 Edit in settings.json。

找到并删除这段：

json
"terminal.integrated.env.windows": {
    "JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS": "-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8"
}
如果里面还有其他配置，只删 "JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS": "-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8" 这一行，保留外面的 {} 为空即可：

json
"terminal.integrated.env.windows": {
}
保存后重启 VS Code 终端。

为什么tnt爆炸之后不破坏方块
专家模式暂不支持搜索，请使用快速模式
因为你装了 WorldGuard，它默认保护了所有爆炸不破坏方块。

解决方法
给 __global__ 区域设置允许 TNT 爆炸破坏：

text
/rg flag __global__ other-explosion allow
或者更精细的设置：

text
/rg flag __global__ creeper-explosion deny
/rg flag __global__ other-explosion allow
如果还不行
检查 plugins/WorldGuard/config.yml：

yaml
ignition:
  block-tnt: false
  block-tnt-block-damage: false
确保 block-tnt-block-damage 是 false。

计算当漏斗在新公式下达到95/个的时候与原本累计相差多少钱
新公式
calcPrice(curlimit) = curlimit * 5

达到 95/个 → curlimit = 95，单次价格 = 95 * 5 = 475

旧公式
java
if (curlimit <= 40) price = 25 * curlimit;
else if (curlimit >= 90) price = 10000;
else price = (int) (1000 * Math.pow(1.05, curlimit - 40));
累计花费对比
等级	旧公式单次	新公式单次	旧累计	新累计	差额
1	25	5	25	5	-20
10	250	50	1,375	275	-1,100
20	500	100	6,375	1,050	-5,325
30	750	150	16,375	2,325	-14,050
40	1,000	200	33,250	4,100	-29,150
50	1,628	250	46,430	6,375	-40,055
60	2,653	300	68,310	9,150	-59,160
70	4,322	350	103,940	12,425	-91,515
80	7,040	400	162,180	16,200	-145,980
90	10,000	450	249,680	20,475	-229,205
95	10,000	475	299,680	22,800	-276,880
结论
达到 95/个时，新公式比旧公式便宜 276,880。新公式整体花费大幅降低。

不是，是95一个的时候
明白了，是单次购买价格达到 95/个 的时候。

新公式
calcPrice(curlimit) = curlimit * 5 = 95

→ curlimit = 19

即漏斗上限为 19 时，新公式单次价格 = 95。

旧公式
旧公式在 curlimit = 19 时：

curlimit <= 40，所以 price = 25 * 19 = 475

累计花费对比（1→19）
公式	累计花费
旧公式	25×(1+2+...+19) = 25×190 = 4,750
新公式	5×(1+2+...+19) = 5×190 = 950
差额
4,750 - 950 = 3,800

新公式便宜 3,800。

现在tnt在玩家点的能炸，复制的就不行，但是单人游戏里可以，怎么回事
专家模式暂不支持搜索，请使用快速模式
TNT 复制被 Paper 服务端禁用了。这就是之前提到的 unsupported-settings。

修复
在 config/paper-world-defaults.yml 中找到或添加：

yaml
unsupported-settings:
  allow-piston-duplication: true
  allow-tnt-duplication: true
如果该文件已经有 unsupported-settings 块，就在里面加上这两行。改完后重启服务器或用 /reload confirm。

如果还不行
Paper 1.21.4 可能已经完全移除了 TNT 复制支持。可以尝试用 paper-world.yml（在每个世界文件夹下）覆盖：

skyworld/paper-world.yml：

yaml
unsupported-settings:
  allow-piston-duplication: true
  allow-tnt-duplication: true
重启后测试。

我已经启用了paper的tnt复制，现在问题是复制出来的tnt爆炸不破坏方块
复制出来的 TNT 被视为"非玩家触发"的爆炸，被 WorldGuard 的 block-other-explosions 拦截了。

修复
检查 plugins/WorldGuard/config.yml：

yaml
mobs:
    block-other-explosions: false
确保是 false。如果是 true，改为 false。

或者用区域 flag 覆盖
text
/rg flag __global__ other-explosion allow
如果还不行
Paper 复制出来的 TNT 可能带有特殊的来源标记，被 WorldGuard 当作"插件生成的爆炸"拦截。检查：

yaml
mobs:
    block-plugin-spawning: true
改为 false 试试。

总结要改的 WorldGuard 配置
yaml
ignition:
    block-tnt: false
    block-tnt-block-damage: false

mobs:
    block-other-explosions: false
    block-plugin-spawning: false
改完 /wg reload。

改了也没用
Paper 1.21.4 可能对复制的 TNT 实体做了特殊标记，导致 WorldGuard 无法识别其来源。

最终方案：用 WorldGuard 区域 flag 直接允许
text
/rg flag __global__ other-explosion allow
/rg flag __global__ tnt allow
执行后测试。如果还不行，检查是否是 uSkyBlock 的岛屿保护拦截了：

在玩家自己的岛屿上测试 TNT 复制，确保不在保护区边界。如果在岛屿上也不行，可能是 uSkyBlock 的 PlayerEvents 中有爆炸拦截逻辑，需要检查源码。

快速验证
临时关闭 WorldGuard 测试：

text
/wg disable
复制 TNT 并引爆，如果能破坏方块，说明确实是 WorldGuard 的问题。如果不能，说明是 Paper 或 uSkyBlock 的问题。测试完执行 /wg enable 重新开启。

Caused by: com.mojang.brigadier.exceptions.CommandSyntaxException: Unknown item 'minecraft:dark_green_stained_glass_pane' at position 0: <--[HERE]
>
challenges.yml 中使用了 dark_green_stained_glass_pane，但 Minecraft 1.21.4 中这个物品的正确名称是 green_stained_glass_pane。

修复
在 challenges.yml 中搜索：

text
dark_green_stained_glass_pane
全部替换为：

text
green_stained_glass_pane
再次提供批量转换原vault权限奖励至lp奖励的正则
正则替换
查找：

text
^(\s+)permission: '(.+)'$
替换为：

text
$1commands:\n$1  - 'console: lp user \{player\} permission set $2 true'
注意：这只转换 permission 字段，原来的 permission 行会被替换为 commands 格式。转换后需要手动调整缩进，确保 commands 在 reward: 下的正确层级。

怎么修改手中物品的名字
方法一：铁砧重命名
对着铁砧右键

把物品放进去

在顶部文本框输入新名字

花费经验值取出

方法二：命令重命名
手持物品，执行：

text
/item modify entity @s weapon.mainhand minecraft:custom_name{"minecraft:custom_name":"{\"text\":\"新名字\",\"color\":\"gold\"}"}
或者用 Essentials：

text
/rename 新名字
需要 essentials.rename 权限。

第一个命令会抹掉附魔吗
第一个命令（/item modify）只会添加/修改自定义名称，不会抹掉附魔。

它只是修改物品的 custom_name 组件，不影响 enchantments 等其他组件。

如果你担心
可以先试试 /item rename（如果 Paper 支持）：

text
/item rename 新名字
这个更简单，也只改名字。

怎么复制手中物品nbt
查看手中物品完整 NBT
text
/data get entity @s SelectedItem
这会显示手中物品的完整数据，包括附魔、名称等。

复制到剪贴板
在聊天框中按 Ctrl+A 全选 → Ctrl+C 复制。

或者导出到文件
text
/execute store result storage minecraft:temp item_data string 1 run data get entity @s SelectedItem
然后查看 world/datapacks/ 下的存储文件。

生成 give 命令
安装了 ItemEdit 或其他物品编辑插件的可以用：

text
/item info
它会直接生成一个可用的 /give 命令到聊天框。

帮我用正则吧所有的          commands:
          - 'console: give {party} minecraft:mooshroom_spawn_egg 1'
          commands:
            - 'console: lp user {player} permission set usb.biome.mushroom_fields true'
改为          commands:
            - 'console: give {party} minecraft:wolf_spawn_egg 1'
            - 'console: lp user {party} permission set usb.biome.forest true'
格式
你的意思是把原来分开的两组 commands 合并成一个 commands 列表，对吗？

正则替换
查找：

text
          commands:\n          - ('console: give \{party\} .+')\n          commands:\n            - ('console: lp user \{player\} .+')
替换为：

text
          commands:
          - $1
          - $2
说明
这会把分开的两个 commands 块合并为一个，并把 {player} 保留原样。如果你还需要把 {player} 改成 {party}，可以再做一次替换：

查找：

text
console: lp user \{player\}
替换为：

text
console: lp user {party}
缩进也要保留，player改party
正则替换
查找：

text
            - 'console: lp user \{player\} permission set (.+)'
替换为：

text
            - 'console: lp user {party} permission set $1'
合并两个 commands 块的正则
查找：

text
\n          commands:\n            - ('console: lp user \{party\} .+')\n          commands:\n            - ('console: give \{party\} .+')
替换为：

text
commands:
            - $1
            - $2
操作顺序
先执行第一个替换（{player} → {party}）

然后把合并的正则进行替换

如果合并的正则匹配不到，说明实际文件中的缩进或换行不同。把需要合并的两段完整代码发给我，我帮你写精确的正则。

木牌放置后就无法编辑了，放箱子上就自动变成什么保护
是的，这是 uSkyBlock 的告示牌任务箱子机制。

原因
当你在箱子上放置木牌并写上 [usb] 后，插件会：

识别这个箱子为任务提交箱子

自动给箱子区域添加保护，防止破坏

锁定木牌，阻止编辑

如果你想编辑木牌内容
需要破坏箱子，重新放置。没有直接编辑已锁定木牌的方法，因为插件的保护机制会阻止你右键打开编辑界面。

如果不想每次都被锁
在 plugins/uSkyBlock/config.yml 中找到相关设置（如果有的话），或者修改源码中 SignEvents.java 的 onSignChanged 方法，去掉锁定逻辑。

不是这个，没加usb，上面写的是[private]名字
专家模式暂不支持搜索，请使用快速模式
那是 BlockLocker 插件干的。它会在你放箱子时自动保护，放木牌到箱子上会显示 [Private]。

关闭自动保护
编辑 plugins/BlockLocker/config.yml：

yaml
auto-protect: false
改完 /blocklocker reload 或重启服务器。

或者只关闭木牌显示
yaml
display-protection-sign: false
这样保护还在，但不会自动放木牌。

我说的是blocklocker
哦，你问的是 /blocklocker 2 这个命令。

/blocklocker 2 可能是想查看 BlockLocker 的第 2 页帮助。正确的命令应该是：

BlockLocker 常用命令
命令	说明
/blocklocker	查看帮助
/blocklocker reload	重载配置
/blocklocker version	查看版本
你之前问的自动保护问题
如果不想 BlockLocker 自动在箱子上放 [Private] 木牌，修改 plugins/BlockLocker/config.yml：

yaml
auto-protect: false
或

yaml
display-protection-sign: false
改完 /blocklocker reload。

BlockLocker 正常加载了。问题是你的 protectableContainers 列表里有 1.21.4 新增的方块（如 copper_chest、*_shelf），但插件版本 1.14.1 还没完全适配这些材质，所以启动时警告。

如果不想要 [Private] 木牌自动放置
添加或修改：

yaml
# 在文件末尾添加
displayProtectionSign: false
或完全关闭自动保护：

yaml
autoProtect: false
但 BlockLocker 1.14.1 可能不支持这个配置项。如果不生效，直接在 protectableContainers 列表中删除 minecraft:chest 和 minecraft:trapped_chest，这样箱子就不会被自动保护了。

挑战gui会多一页空白页面是怎么回事
这是因为 challenges.yml 中某个 Rank（挑战组）没有任何挑战，或者某个挑战设置了 showInList: false 但它的 offset 仍占用了页面空间。

检查以下几点
空 Rank：查看 challenges.yml 中是否有一个 Rank 下的 challenges: 为空或所有挑战都被注释掉了。

showInList: false 的挑战：比如 page1finished、tier1_complete 这些隐藏挑战，检查它们的 offset 是否为 0。

offset 设置：挑战的 offset 如果设置为 -1，会让它占据额外空间但不可见。

快速定位
在游戏里执行：

text
/usb ch list
看看有哪些挑战组是空的。把你 challenges.yml 中 Rank 的 Tier7 和之后的配置发给我，我帮你找空白页的原因。

version: 108
找到问题了。你的 mushroom_biome 挑战中有两个 commands 键：

yaml
      mushroom_biome:
        ...
        reward:
          text: 1个哞菇刷怪蛋，解锁蘑菇岛生物群系
          commands:
          - 'console: give {party} minecraft:mooshroom_spawn_egg 1'
          commands:
            - 'console: lp user {party} permission set usb.biome.mushroom_fields true'
这导致 YAML 解析时第二个 commands 覆盖了第一个，而且可能导致页面计算异常。

修复
查找：

yaml
          commands:
          - 'console: give {party} minecraft:mooshroom_spawn_egg 1'
          commands:
            - 'console: lp user {party} permission set usb.biome.mushroom_fields true'
替换为：

yaml
          commands:
          - 'console: give {party} minecraft:mooshroom_spawn_egg 1'
          - 'console: lp user {party} permission set usb.biome.mushroom_fields true'
另外
end_portal 挑战引用了一个不存在的挑战：

yaml
        requiredChallenges:
        - end_portal_frame_assembly
end_portal_frame_assembly 这个挑战不存在。你需要改成已有的挑战，或者新建这个挑战。

第四页完全空的还是存在
第四页是 Tier4，它下面有挑战，应该不是完全空的。

检查 Tier4 的 rankLeeway
yaml
  Tier4:
    requires:
      rankLeeway: 3
      challenges:
      - tier3_complete
rankLeeway: 3 意味着玩家还没完成 tier3_complete 时，可以提前看到 Tier4，但挑战是锁定的。这会导致 Tier4 显示出来但所有挑战都是锁定的。

但这不会导致空白页。

真正原因
你的 Tier4 有 8 个挑战 + 1 个隐藏挑战 page1finished。每个 Rank 显示时，ChallengeLogic.populateChallengeRank 会计算该 Rank 占用的行数。如果挑战数量刚好填满或溢出页面，可能会多出一页空白。

快速验证
在游戏里执行：

text
/usb ch list
看看 Tier4 是否被识别为有效 Rank。如果是，可能是 page1finished 的 offset 导致页面计算多了一页。

把 page1finished 的 offset 改为 -1（跳过该挑战的页面占用）：

yaml
      page1finished:
        offset: -1
如果已经有 offset 设置，发给我，我帮你看。

不，那是第四个等级，usb会自动把每页放不下的等级排到下一页去
明白了，那就是 Tier3 和 Tier4 加起来超过了每页能显示的挑战组数量，导致 Tier4 被排到了下一页，而且因为它的挑战数不多，看起来像是空白的。

这是正常行为
uSkyBlock 按 Rank 分配页面。如果前几个 Rank 的挑战太多，后面的 Rank 会被挤到下一页。这不是 bug，是挑战组太多导致的。

如果你想让所有 Rank 都在前三页
减少每个 Rank 的挑战数量

或者增加 ROWS_OF_RANKS（在 ChallengeLogic.java 中，默认是 5 行/页）

或者接受 Tier4 在第四页

为商店添加一个新功能，以分类的形式展示在第一个分类，功能内容类似于《暗区突围》中文森商店，该分类每天6. 12. 18.自动刷新，随机上架45个满足所有条件（该分类下商品种类不重复、是商店中已有的商品、单次购买给予数量根据稀有度为4的倍数、是商店中商品原价的随机20%-80%、随机限购1-3次、不会增长价格）的商品，也不计入原商品的购买上限
我们收到一个需求：为商店添加一个“文森商店”功能，以分类形式展示在第一个分类，每天6、12、18点自动刷新，随机上架45个商品，条件：商品种类不重复、是商店中已有的商品、单次购买给予数量根据稀有度为4的倍数、价格是原价的随机20%-80%、随机限购1-3次、不计入原商品购买上限、不会增长价格。需要实现这个功能。

我们需要设计数据模型和逻辑，修改插件。

分析需求：

新增一个特殊分类，放在商店第一个位置，显示名称类似“文森商店”或“刷新商店”。

该分类的商品是动态的，每天6、12、18点刷新（随机选取45个）。

商品来源于其他已有分类的商品，但条件不重复（每个商店已有商品只会出现一次）。

商品属性要变化：给予数量根据“稀有度”为4的倍数？稀有度可能需要定义：可能基于物品本身、价格或配置。简单实现：按原商品的价格范围分稀有度？或者我们可以在shop.yml中为每个商品定义一个稀有度（stars/rarity），如果没有则默认1。数量=稀有度*4。

价格是原价随机20%-80%。

限购1-3次随机，不增长价格，不计入原商品上限，也就是独立计数。

刷新机制：定时任务，每天三个时间点刷新。

我们需要实现：

数据存储：需要一个地方存储当前“文森商店”的商品快照，以及玩家购买计数（独立于原商品）。

定时任务：在ShopLogic或新的类中，注册定时任务，在6,12,18点刷新商品。

GUI显示：在displayShopGUI中，如果categoryId是特殊分类，则展示这些快照商品，价格、数量、限购等用快照数据，而不是原ShopItem。

购买逻辑：购买时，扣除对应价格（快照价格），给予对应数量物品，检查独立限购，不计入原计数。

由于改动较大，需要分步进行。用户可能会提供进一步指导，我们先设计一个方案，然后按照方案逐步输出代码修改。

关键设计：

在shop.yml中是否可以定义这个特殊分类？我们可以新加一个分类，type为“random_shop”之类的，但现有配置结构可能不支持。最简单的是在ShopLogic中硬编码一个特殊分类ID，比如“random_shop”，它的物品不来自yml，而是动态生成的。

刷新时机：使用Bukkit的调度器，计算到下一次刷新时间。

快照数据结构：RandomShopItem 包含：原ShopItem引用（用于获取原价等），当前价格，限购次数，给予数量。以及当前购买计数（每个玩家）。

玩家计数独立，可以用类似于PlayerShopData但独立的Map，或者扩展PlayerShopData，添加randomShopBuyCounts。

数量为“稀有度”的4倍数。稀有度如何定义？可以在shop.yml中给每个商品增加一个可选的 rarity 字段，默认1。如果没有，我们就用默认1。那么数量 = rarity * 4。

刷新逻辑：每次刷新，从所有已加载的ShopItem中（即所有分类的所有物品）随机选出45个，每个原商品唯一。如果总商品少于45，则全部显示。生成随机价格、限购、数量。存储到内存，并重置所有玩家在此商店的购买计数。

定时任务：在ShopLogic中，启动时计算下一次刷新时间，然后调度任务。刷新时重新生成。

GUI显示：在displayShopGUI中，如果categoryId是特殊ID，则读取快照商品列表，构建lore（价格、限购、数量等），点击购买调用专门的方法buyRandomShopItem。

buyRandomShopItem：检查独立限购，扣除价格，发放物品（数量为快照中的数量），增加独立购买计数，不增加原商品计数。

需要修改的文件：

ShopItem.java：可能需要一个复制构造函数或方法，但我们可以直接在快照中存原ShopItem引用。

ShopLogic.java：添加定时任务、快照生成方法、获取快照列表、购买逻辑、独立计数存储。

SkyBlockMenu.java：修改displayShopGUI和onClickShopMenu，处理特殊分类。

shop.yml：不需要修改，特殊分类是内置的。

考虑到复杂度，我们先提供一个实现方案并输出代码，用户可以进行测试。由于我们不能实际运行，需要确保逻辑正确。

开始组织回答：首先简要说明新增功能，然后给出代码修改指导。由于代码量较大，我将在回答中分步提供关键代码片段和修改位置。

我们还需要注意：特殊分类放在第一个，即显示顺序上，它应该排在分类列表最前面。可以在getCategories时，在列表开头插入这个特殊分类。

下面开始编写具体实现。

新功能：文森商店（随机折扣商店）
功能描述
在商店分类最前面添加一个特殊分类“文森商店”，每天 6:00、12:00、18:00 自动刷新。

每次刷新从所有已存在的商品中随机抽取最多 45 个不重复的商品。

每个商品随机打折（原价的 20%~80%），随机限购 1~3 次，实际购买数量 = 稀有度 × 4（稀有度默认 1，可在 shop.yml 中自定义）。

购买不计入原商品的购买上限，价格不会递增，有独立的购买次数限制。

刷新时重置所有玩家的购买记录。

实现步骤
1. 新增数据模型
在 shop 包下新建 RandomShopItem.java：

java
package us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.shop;

import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
import us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.uSkyBlock;

import java.util.Random;

public class RandomShopItem {
    private final ShopItem originalItem;
    private final double discountedPrice;
    private final int maxBuys;
    private final int giveAmount;

    public RandomShopItem(ShopItem originalItem) {
        this.originalItem = originalItem;
        Random rnd = new Random();
        // 价格随机 20% ~ 80%
        double percent = 0.2 + rnd.nextDouble() * 0.6;
        this.discountedPrice = originalItem.getBaseCost() * percent;
        // 限购 1~3
        this.maxBuys = 1 + rnd.nextInt(3);
        // 数量 = 稀有度 * 4
        int rarity = getRarity(originalItem);
        this.giveAmount = rarity * 4;
    }

    private int getRarity(ShopItem item) {
        // 可以从 shop.yml 中读取，这里暂时返回默认值 1
        // 如果以后需要配置，可在 ShopItem 中添加 rarity 字段
        return 1;
    }

    public ShopItem getOriginalItem() { return originalItem; }
    public double getDiscountedPrice() { return discountedPrice; }
    public int getMaxBuys() { return maxBuys; }
    public int getGiveAmount() { return giveAmount; }
}
2. 扩展 PlayerShopData，支持文森商店独立计数
修改 PlayerShopData.java，添加：

java
private final Map<String, Integer> randomShopBuys = new HashMap<>();

public int getRandomShopBuyCount(String itemId) {
    return randomShopBuys.getOrDefault(itemId, 0);
}
public void incrementRandomShopBuyCount(String itemId) {
    randomShopBuys.put(itemId, getRandomShopBuyCount(itemId) + 1);
}
public void resetRandomShopBuys() {
    randomShopBuys.clear();
}

// 序列化/反序列化也要加上这部分，但为了简化可暂不持久化
3. 修改 ShopLogic.java
添加文森商店核心逻辑：

java
// 特殊分类ID
public static final String RANDOM_SHOP_CATEGORY_ID = "__random_shop__";

// 当前快照
private final List<RandomShopItem> randomShopItems = new ArrayList<>();
private final Random random = new Random();

// 初始化定时任务
private void scheduleRefresh() {
    // 计算到下一个 6/12/18 点的毫秒数，然后调度
    // 这里简化，直接在 loadConfig 后调用一次 refreshRandomShop()
    refreshRandomShop();
    // 启动定时任务（使用 plugin.getScheduler()）
    // ...
}

// 刷新文森商店
public void refreshRandomShop() {
    randomShopItems.clear();
    // 收集所有可用的 ShopItem
    List<ShopItem> allItems = new ArrayList<>();
    for (ShopCategory cat : categories.values()) {
        allItems.addAll(cat.getItems());
    }
    // 打乱并取前 45
    Collections.shuffle(allItems, random);
    int count = Math.min(45, allItems.size());
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        randomShopItems.add(new RandomShopItem(allItems.get(i)));
    }
    // 重置所有玩家的独立购买计数
    // 遍历在线玩家或直接清空 playerData 中的计数？
    // 这里需要遍历 playerData 并调用 resetRandomShopBuys
    playerData.values().forEach(PlayerShopData::resetRandomShopBuys);
}

// 获取特殊分类（如果不存在则创建）
public ShopCategory getRandomShopCategory() {
    // 在 getCategories() 时动态生成一个分类对象
    return new ShopCategory(RANDOM_SHOP_CATEGORY_ID,
        "&d文森商店",
        new ItemStack(Material.EMERALD), // 图标
        Collections.emptyList()); // 实际物品在 GUI 中单独处理
}
同时修改 getCategories() 方法，将特殊分类插入到列表最前面：

java
public List<ShopCategory> getCategories() {
    List<ShopCategory> cats = new ArrayList<>(categories.values());
    // 插入文森商店到首位
    cats.addFirst(getRandomShopCategory());
    return cats;
}
还需要添加购买方法：

java
public boolean canBuyRandomShopItem(PlayerShopData data, RandomShopItem rItem) {
    return data.getRandomShopBuyCount(rItem.getOriginalItem().getId()) < rItem.getMaxBuys();
}

public void buyRandomShopItem(Player player, PlayerShopData data, RandomShopItem rItem) {
    data.incrementRandomShopBuyCount(rItem.getOriginalItem().getId());
    // 扣钱、给物品由外部处理
}

public double getRandomShopPrice(RandomShopItem rItem) {
    return rItem.getDiscountedPrice();
}

实现 buyRandomShopItem：

java
private void buyRandomShopItem(Player player, RandomShopItem rItem) {
    UUID uuid = player.getUniqueId();
    ShopLogic shopLogic = plugin.getShopLogic();
    PlayerShopData data = shopLogic.getPlayerData(uuid);

    if (!shopLogic.canBuyRandomShopItem(data, rItem)) {
        player.sendMessage(tr("§c已达到限购次数！"));
        return;
    }
    double price = shopLogic.getRandomShopPrice(rItem);
    plugin.getHookManager().getEconomyHook().ifPresent(hook -> {
        if (hook.getBalance(player) < price) {
            player.sendMessage(tr("§c余额不足！"));
            return;
        }
        hook.withdrawPlayer(player, price);
        // 给予物品（数量为 rItem.getGiveAmount()）
        ItemStack reward = rItem.getOriginalItem().getDisplayItem().clone();
        reward.setAmount(rItem.getGiveAmount());
        HashMap<Integer, ItemStack> leftover = player.getInventory().addItem(reward);
        leftover.values().forEach(i -> player.getWorld().dropItem(player.getLocation(), i));
        shopLogic.buyRandomShopItem(player, data, rItem);
        player.sendMessage(tr("§a购买成功！"));
    });
    player.openInventory(displayShopGUI(player, RANDOM_SHOP_CATEGORY_ID, 1));
}

package us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.shop;

import com.google.inject.Inject;
import com.google.inject.Singleton;
import dk.lockfuglsang.minecraft.file.FileUtil;
import dk.lockfuglsang.minecraft.util.ItemStackUtil;
import org.bukkit.configuration.ConfigurationSection;
import org.bukkit.configuration.file.FileConfiguration;
import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.uSkyBlock;
import us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.player.PlayerInfo;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Arrays;

@Singleton
public class ShopLogic {
    private final uSkyBlock plugin;
    private final Logger logger;
    private final FileConfiguration config;
    private final Map<String, ShopCategory> categories = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final Map<UUID, PlayerShopData> playerData = new HashMap<>();
    private double priceIncreasePercent;
    private long resetMinutes;

    @Inject
    public ShopLogic(@NotNull uSkyBlock plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
        this.logger = plugin.getLogger();
        this.config = FileUtil.getYmlConfiguration("shop.yml");
        loadConfig();
    }

    private void loadConfig() {
        categories.clear();
        this.priceIncreasePercent = config.getDouble("price-increase.increase-percent", 25);
        this.resetMinutes = config.getLong("price-increase.reset-minutes", 60);

        ConfigurationSection catSection = config.getConfigurationSection("categories");
        if (catSection == null) return;

        for (String catId : catSection.getKeys(false)) {
            ConfigurationSection cat = catSection.getConfigurationSection(catId);
            if (cat == null) continue;

            String name = cat.getString("name", catId);
            ItemStack displayItem = ItemStackUtil.createItemStack(cat.getString("displayItem", "STONE"));

            List<ShopItem> items = new ArrayList<>();
            ConfigurationSection itemSection = cat.getConfigurationSection("items");
            if (itemSection != null) {
                for (String itemId : itemSection.getKeys(false)) {
                    ConfigurationSection item = itemSection.getConfigurationSection(itemId);
                    if (item == null) continue;

                    ItemStack itemDisplay = ItemStackUtil.createItemStack(
                        item.getString("displayItem", "STONE"));
                    String displayName = item.getString("displayName");
                    double cost = item.getDouble("cost", 10);
                    int maxBuys = item.getInt("max-buys", 64);
                    int requiredLevel = item.getInt("required-level", 0);
                    List<String> requiredChallenges = item.getStringList("required-challenges");

                    List<String> itemRewards = item.getStringList("items");
                    if (itemRewards.isEmpty() && item.getString("items") != null) {
                        itemRewards.addAll(Arrays.asList(item.getString("items").split(" ")));
                    }

                    List<String> commands = item.getStringList("commands");
                    if (commands.isEmpty() && item.getString("commands") != null) {
                        commands.add(item.getString("commands"));
                    }

                    String bundleName = item.getString("bundle.name");
                    List<String> bundleDesc = item.getStringList("bundle.description");

                    items.add(new ShopItem(itemId, itemDisplay, displayName, cost, maxBuys,
                        requiredLevel, requiredChallenges, itemRewards, commands,
                        bundleName, bundleDesc));
                }
            }
            categories.put(catId, new ShopCategory(catId, name, displayItem, items));
        }
    }

    public List<ShopCategory> getCategories() {
        return new ArrayList<>(categories.values());
    }

    public ShopCategory getCategory(String id) {
        return categories.get(id);
    }

    public PlayerShopData getPlayerData(UUID uuid) {
        PlayerShopData data = playerData.get(uuid);
        if (data == null) {
            // 尝试从玩家数据文件加载
            PlayerInfo pi = plugin.getPlayerInfo(uuid);
            if (pi != null) {
                data = PlayerShopData.load(pi.getConfig().getConfigurationSection("shop"));
            } else {
                data = new PlayerShopData();
            }
            playerData.put(uuid, data);
        }
        data.resetIfNeeded(resetMinutes);
        return data;
    }

    public void savePlayerData(UUID uuid) {
        PlayerShopData data = playerData.get(uuid);
        if (data != null) {
            PlayerInfo pi = plugin.getPlayerInfo(uuid);
            if (pi != null) {
                data.save(pi.getConfig().createSection("shop"));
                pi.save();
            }
        }
    }

    public double getCurrentPrice(ShopItem item, UUID playerUuid) {
        PlayerShopData data = getPlayerData(playerUuid);
        int buyCount = data.getBuyCount(item.getId());
        double price = item.getBaseCost();
        for (int i = 0; i < buyCount; i++) {
            price *= (1 + priceIncreasePercent / 100.0);
        }
        return price;
    }

    public int getActualPrice(ShopItem item, UUID playerUuid) {
        return (int) Math.floor(getCurrentPrice(item, playerUuid));
    }

    public boolean canBuy(ShopItem item, UUID playerUuid) {
        PlayerShopData data = getPlayerData(playerUuid);
        // 检查最大购买数量
        if (data.getBuyCount(item.getId()) >= item.getMaxBuys()) {
            return false;
        }
        // 检查岛屿等级（由调用方检查）
        // 检查任务完成（由调用方检查）
        return true;
    }

    public void reload() {
        FileUtil.reload();
        loadConfig();
        logger.info("ShopLogic: shop.yml reloaded. Loaded " + categories.size() + " categories.");
    }
}

第一步：新建 RandomShopItem.java
在 us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.shop 包下新建 RandomShopItem.java：

java
package us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.shop;

import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
import java.util.Random;

public class RandomShopItem {
    private final ShopItem originalItem;
    private final double discountedPrice;
    private final int maxBuys;
    private final int giveAmount;

    public RandomShopItem(ShopItem originalItem) {
        this.originalItem = originalItem;
        Random rnd = new Random();
        // 价格随机 20% ~ 80%
        double percent = 0.2 + rnd.nextDouble() * 0.6;
        this.discountedPrice = originalItem.getBaseCost() * percent;
        // 限购 1~3
        this.maxBuys = 1 + rnd.nextInt(3);
        // 数量 = 稀有度 * 4，稀有度默认 1（后续可在 ShopItem 中扩展）
        this.giveAmount = getRarity(originalItem) * 4;
    }

    private int getRarity(ShopItem item) {
        // 暂时默认 1，以后可以读取配置或 ShopItem 的新字段
        return 1;
    }

    public ShopItem getOriginalItem() { return originalItem; }
    public double getDiscountedPrice() { return discountedPrice; }
    public int getMaxBuys() { return maxBuys; }
    public int getGiveAmount() { return giveAmount; }
}

3. 添加定时刷新方法（放在文件末尾 reload() 方法附近）

java
    private void scheduleRandomShopRefresh() {
        refreshRandomShop(); // 立即执行一次
        long current = System.currentTimeMillis();
        java.util.Calendar cal = java.util.Calendar.getInstance();
        cal.set(java.util.Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, 6);
        cal.set(java.util.Calendar.MINUTE, 0);
        cal.set(java.util.Calendar.SECOND, 0);
        long first6 = cal.getTimeInMillis();
        if (current > first6) first6 += 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
        long delay6 = first6 - current;
        // 使用 Bukkit 调度器，每 6 小时执行一次
        plugin.getScheduler().sync(() -> {
            refreshRandomShop();
            // 之后每 6 小时执行一次
            plugin.getScheduler().sync(() -> refreshRandomShop(), Duration.ofHours(6), Duration.ofHours(6));
        }, Duration.ofMillis(delay6));
    }

    public void refreshRandomShop() {
        randomShopItems.clear();
        // 收集所有普通商品
        List<ShopItem> allItems = new ArrayList<>();
        for (ShopCategory cat : categories.values()) {
            allItems.addAll(cat.getItems());
        }
        // 打乱并取前 45
        java.util.Collections.shuffle(allItems, random);
        int count = Math.min(45, allItems.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            randomShopItems.add(new RandomShopItem(allItems.get(i)));
        }
        // 重置所有玩家的文森商店购买计数
        for (PlayerShopData data : playerData.values()) {
            data.resetRandomShopBuys();
        }
        logger.info("文森商店已刷新，上架 " + randomShopItems.size() + " 件商品");
    }

    public List<RandomShopItem> getRandomShopItems() {
        return new ArrayList<>(randomShopItems);
    }

    public ShopCategory getRandomShopCategory() {
        // 生成虚拟分类，用于 GUI 显示
        return new ShopCategory(
            RANDOM_SHOP_CATEGORY_ID,
            "&d文森商店",
            new org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack(org.bukkit.Material.EMERALD),
            java.util.Collections.emptyList()
        );
    }

    private final Map<String, Integer> randomShopBuys = new HashMap<>();

    public int getRandomShopBuyCount(String itemId) {
        return randomShopBuys.getOrDefault(itemId, 0);
    }

    public void incrementRandomShopBuyCount(String itemId) {
        randomShopBuys.put(itemId, getRandomShopBuyCount(itemId) + 1);
    }

    public void resetRandomShopBuys() {
        randomShopBuys.clear();
    }

3. 添加 buyRandomShopItem 方法

在 SkyBlockMenu 末尾新增：

java
    private void buyRandomShopItem(Player player, RandomShopItem rItem) {
        UUID uuid = player.getUniqueId();
        ShopLogic shopLogic = plugin.getShopLogic();
        PlayerShopData data = shopLogic.getPlayerData(uuid);

        if (data.getRandomShopBuyCount(rItem.getOriginalItem().getId()) >= rItem.getMaxBuys()) {
            player.sendMessage(tr("\u00a7c已达到限购次数！"));
            return;
        }

        double price = rItem.getDiscountedPrice();
        plugin.getHookManager().getEconomyHook().ifPresent(hook -> {
            if (hook.getBalance(player) < price) {
                player.sendMessage(tr("\u00a7c余额不足！"));
                return;
            }
            hook.withdrawPlayer(player, price);
            // 给予物品
            ItemStack reward = rItem.getOriginalItem().getDisplayItem().clone();
            reward.setAmount(rItem.getGiveAmount());
            HashMap<Integer, ItemStack> leftovers = player.getInventory().addItem(reward);
            leftovers.values().forEach(i -> player.getWorld().dropItem(player.getLocation(), i));
            data.incrementRandomShopBuyCount(rItem.getOriginalItem().getId());
            shopLogic.savePlayerData(uuid);
            player.sendMessage(tr("\u00a7a购买成功！"));
        });
        player.openInventory(displayShopGUI(player, RANDOM_SHOP_CATEGORY_ID, 1));
    }

1. 新建 RandomShopItem.java
路径：uSkyBlock-Core/src/main/java/us/talabrek/ultimateskyblock/shop/RandomShopItem.java

java
package us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.shop;

import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * 文森商店随机商品，每次刷新时随机生成折扣、限购次数和数量。
 */
public class RandomShopItem {
    private final ShopItem originalItem;
    private final double discountedPrice;
    private final int maxBuys;
    private final int giveAmount;

    public RandomShopItem(ShopItem originalItem) {
        this.originalItem = originalItem;
        Random rnd = new Random();
        // 价格随机 20% ~ 80%
        double percent = 0.2 + rnd.nextDouble() * 0.6;
        this.discountedPrice = originalItem.getBaseCost() * percent;
        // 限购 1~3
        this.maxBuys = 1 + rnd.nextInt(3);
        // 数量 = 稀有度 * 4，稀有度暂时默认1（后续可配置）
        this.giveAmount = getRarity(originalItem) * 4;
    }

    private int getRarity(ShopItem item) {
        // 暂时返回 1，以后可扩展读取 ShopItem 的稀有度字段
        return 1;
    }

    public ShopItem getOriginalItem() { return originalItem; }
    public double getDiscountedPrice() { return discountedPrice; }
    public int getMaxBuys() { return maxBuys; }
    public int getGiveAmount() { return giveAmount; }
}
2. 修改后的 ShopLogic.java
java
package us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.shop;

import com.google.inject.Inject;
import com.google.inject.Singleton;
import dk.lockfuglsang.minecraft.file.FileUtil;
import dk.lockfuglsang.minecraft.util.ItemStackUtil;
import org.bukkit.Material;
import org.bukkit.configuration.ConfigurationSection;
import org.bukkit.configuration.file.FileConfiguration;
import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.uSkyBlock;
import us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.player.PlayerInfo;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Calendar;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Random;

@Singleton
public class ShopLogic {
    // 文森商店特殊分类ID
    public static final String RANDOM_SHOP_CATEGORY_ID = "__random_shop__";

    private final uSkyBlock plugin;
    private final Logger logger;
    private final FileConfiguration config;
    private final Map<String, ShopCategory> categories = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final Map<UUID, PlayerShopData> playerData = new HashMap<>();
    private double priceIncreasePercent;
    private long resetMinutes;

    // 文森商店当前快照
    private final List<RandomShopItem> randomShopItems = new ArrayList<>();
    private final Random random = new Random();

    @Inject
    public ShopLogic(@NotNull uSkyBlock plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
        this.logger = plugin.getLogger();
        this.config = FileUtil.getYmlConfiguration("shop.yml");
        loadConfig();
        scheduleRandomShopRefresh(); // 启动文森商店定时刷新
    }

    private void loadConfig() {
        categories.clear();
        this.priceIncreasePercent = config.getDouble("price-increase.increase-percent", 25);
        this.resetMinutes = config.getLong("price-increase.reset-minutes", 60);

        ConfigurationSection catSection = config.getConfigurationSection("categories");
        if (catSection == null) return;

        for (String catId : catSection.getKeys(false)) {
            ConfigurationSection cat = catSection.getConfigurationSection(catId);
            if (cat == null) continue;

            String name = cat.getString("name", catId);
            ItemStack displayItem = ItemStackUtil.createItemStack(cat.getString("displayItem", "STONE"));

            List<ShopItem> items = new ArrayList<>();
            ConfigurationSection itemSection = cat.getConfigurationSection("items");
            if (itemSection != null) {
                for (String itemId : itemSection.getKeys(false)) {
                    ConfigurationSection item = itemSection.getConfigurationSection(itemId);
                    if (item == null) continue;

                    ItemStack itemDisplay = ItemStackUtil.createItemStack(
                        item.getString("displayItem", "STONE"));
                    String displayName = item.getString("displayName");
                    double cost = item.getDouble("cost", 10);
                    int maxBuys = item.getInt("max-buys", 64);
                    int requiredLevel = item.getInt("required-level", 0);
                    List<String> requiredChallenges = item.getStringList("required-challenges");

                    List<String> itemRewards = item.getStringList("items");
                    if (itemRewards.isEmpty() && item.getString("items") != null) {
                        itemRewards.addAll(Arrays.asList(item.getString("items").split(" ")));
                    }

                    List<String> commands = item.getStringList("commands");
                    if (commands.isEmpty() && item.getString("commands") != null) {
                        commands.add(item.getString("commands"));
                    }

                    String bundleName = item.getString("bundle.name");
                    List<String> bundleDesc = item.getStringList("bundle.description");

                    items.add(new ShopItem(itemId, itemDisplay, displayName, cost, maxBuys,
                        requiredLevel, requiredChallenges, itemRewards, commands,
                        bundleName, bundleDesc));
                }
            }
            categories.put(catId, new ShopCategory(catId, name, displayItem, items));
        }
    }

    // ==================== 文森商店 ====================

    private void scheduleRandomShopRefresh() {
        // 立即刷新一次
        refreshRandomShop();

        // 计算到下一个 6:00, 12:00, 18:00 的毫秒数
        long current = System.currentTimeMillis();
        Calendar cal = Calendar.getInstance();
        cal.set(Calendar.MINUTE, 0);
        cal.set(Calendar.SECOND, 0);
        cal.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);

        // 尝试 6,12,18 点，找到下一个最近的时间
        long delay = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        int[] hours = {6, 12, 18};
        for (int h : hours) {
            cal.set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, h);
            long time = cal.getTimeInMillis();
            if (time <= current) {
                time += 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 明天
            }
            long d = time - current;
            if (d < delay) {
                delay = d;
            }
        }

        // 使用 uSkyBlock 调度器
        plugin.getScheduler().sync(() -> {
            refreshRandomShop();
            // 之后每 6 小时刷新一次
            plugin.getScheduler().sync(this::refreshRandomShop, Duration.ofHours(6), Duration.ofHours(6));
        }, Duration.ofMillis(delay));
    }

    public void refreshRandomShop() {
        randomShopItems.clear();
        // 收集所有普通商品
        List<ShopItem> allItems = new ArrayList<>();
        for (ShopCategory cat : categories.values()) {
            allItems.addAll(cat.getItems());
        }
        if (allItems.isEmpty()) return;

        // 打乱并取前 45
        Collections.shuffle(allItems, random);
        int count = Math.min(45, allItems.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            randomShopItems.add(new RandomShopItem(allItems.get(i)));
        }

        // 重置所有玩家的文森购买次数
        for (PlayerShopData data : playerData.values()) {
            data.resetRandomShopBuys();
        }
        logger.info("文森商店已刷新，上架 " + randomShopItems.size() + " 件商品");
    }

    public List<RandomShopItem> getRandomShopItems() {
        return new ArrayList<>(randomShopItems);
    }

    public ShopCategory getRandomShopCategory() {
        return new ShopCategory(
            RANDOM_SHOP_CATEGORY_ID,
            "&d文森商店",
            new ItemStack(Material.EMERALD),
            Collections.emptyList()
        );
    }

    // ==================== 覆盖 getCategories，插入文森商店 ====================

    public List<ShopCategory> getCategories() {
        List<ShopCategory> cats = new ArrayList<>();
        cats.add(getRandomShopCategory());
        cats.addAll(categories.values());
        return cats;
    }

    // ==================== 原有方法 ====================

    public ShopCategory getCategory(String id) {
        if (RANDOM_SHOP_CATEGORY_ID.equals(id)) {
            return getRandomShopCategory();
        }
        return categories.get(id);
    }

    public PlayerShopData getPlayerData(UUID uuid) {
        PlayerShopData data = playerData.get(uuid);
        if (data == null) {
            PlayerInfo pi = plugin.getPlayerInfo(uuid);
            if (pi != null) {
                data = PlayerShopData.load(pi.getConfig().getConfigurationSection("shop"));
            } else {
                data = new PlayerShopData();
            }
            playerData.put(uuid, data);
        }
        data.resetIfNeeded(resetMinutes);
        return data;
    }

    public void savePlayerData(UUID uuid) {
        PlayerShopData data = playerData.get(uuid);
        if (data != null) {
            PlayerInfo pi = plugin.getPlayerInfo(uuid);
            if (pi != null) {
                data.save(pi.getConfig().createSection("shop"));
                pi.save();
            }
        }
    }

    public double getCurrentPrice(ShopItem item, UUID playerUuid) {
        PlayerShopData data = getPlayerData(playerUuid);
        int buyCount = data.getBuyCount(item.getId());
        double price = item.getBaseCost();
        for (int i = 0; i < buyCount; i++) {
            price *= (1 + priceIncreasePercent / 100.0);
        }
        return price;
    }

    public int getActualPrice(ShopItem item, UUID playerUuid) {
        return (int) Math.floor(getCurrentPrice(item, playerUuid));
    }

    public boolean canBuy(ShopItem item, UUID playerUuid) {
        PlayerShopData data = getPlayerData(playerUuid);
        return data.getBuyCount(item.getId()) < item.getMaxBuys();
    }

    public void reload() {
        FileUtil.reload();
        loadConfig();
        logger.info("ShopLogic: shop.yml reloaded. Loaded " + categories.size() + " categories.");
    }
}
3. 修改 PlayerShopData.java（添加文森购买记录）
java
// 在 PlayerShopData 中添加以下字段和方法
private final Map<String, Integer> randomShopBuys = new HashMap<>();

public int getRandomShopBuyCount(String itemId) {
    return randomShopBuys.getOrDefault(itemId, 0);
}

public void incrementRandomShopBuyCount(String itemId) {
    randomShopBuys.put(itemId, getRandomShopBuyCount(itemId) + 1);
}

public void resetRandomShopBuys() {
    randomShopBuys.clear();
}

// 如果需要持久化，可在 save/load 中加入：
public void save(ConfigurationSection section) {
    section.set("lastResetTime", lastResetTime);
    for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> entry : buyCounts.entrySet()) {
        section.set("buyCounts." + entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
    }
    // 保存文森购买次数
    for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> entry : randomShopBuys.entrySet()) {
        section.set("randomShopBuys." + entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
    }
}

public static PlayerShopData load(ConfigurationSection section) {
    PlayerShopData data = new PlayerShopData();
    if (section != null) {
        data.lastResetTime = section.getLong("lastResetTime", Instant.now().getEpochSecond());
        ConfigurationSection counts = section.getConfigurationSection("buyCounts");
        if (counts != null) {
            for (String key : counts.getKeys(false)) {
                data.buyCounts.put(key, counts.getInt(key));
            }
        }
        ConfigurationSection randomCounts = section.getConfigurationSection("randomShopBuys");
        if (randomCounts != null) {
            for (String key : randomCounts.getKeys(false)) {
                data.randomShopBuys.put(key, randomCounts.getInt(key));
            }
        }
    }
    return data;
}

4.3 在 SkyBlockMenu 末尾新增 buyRandomShopItem 方法
java
    private void buyRandomShopItem(Player player, RandomShopItem rItem) {
        UUID uuid = player.getUniqueId();
        ShopLogic shopLogic = plugin.getShopLogic();
        PlayerShopData data = shopLogic.getPlayerData(uuid);

        if (data.getRandomShopBuyCount(rItem.getOriginalItem().getId()) >= rItem.getMaxBuys()) {
            player.sendMessage(tr("\u00a7c已达到限购次数！"));
            return;
        }

        double price = rItem.getDiscountedPrice();
        plugin.getHookManager().getEconomyHook().ifPresent(hook -> {
            if (hook.getBalance(player) < price) {
                player.sendMessage(tr("\u00a7c余额不足！"));
                return;
            }
            hook.withdrawPlayer(player, price);
            // 给予物品
            ItemStack reward = rItem.getOriginalItem().getDisplayItem().clone();
            reward.setAmount(rItem.getGiveAmount());
            HashMap<Integer, ItemStack> leftovers = player.getInventory().addItem(reward);
            leftovers.values().forEach(i -> player.getWorld().dropItem(player.getLocation(), i));
            data.incrementRandomShopBuyCount(rItem.getOriginalItem().getId());
            shopLogic.savePlayerData(uuid);
            player.sendMessage(tr("\u00a7a购买成功！"));
        });
        player.openInventory(displayShopGUI(player, ShopLogic.RANDOM_SHOP_CATEGORY_ID, 1));
    }

java
package us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.shop;

import com.google.inject.Inject;
import com.google.inject.Singleton;
import dk.lockfuglsang.minecraft.file.FileUtil;
import dk.lockfuglsang.minecraft.util.ItemStackUtil;
import org.bukkit.Material;
import org.bukkit.configuration.ConfigurationSection;
import org.bukkit.configuration.file.FileConfiguration;
import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.uSkyBlock;
import us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.player.PlayerInfo;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Calendar;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Random;

@Singleton
public class ShopLogic {
    public static final String RANDOM_SHOP_CATEGORY_ID = "__random_shop__";

    private final uSkyBlock plugin;
    private final Logger logger;
    private final FileConfiguration config;
    private final Map<String, ShopCategory> categories = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final Map<UUID, PlayerShopData> playerData = new HashMap<>();
    private double priceIncreasePercent;
    private long resetMinutes;

    private final List<RandomShopItem> randomShopItems = new ArrayList<>();
    private final Random random = new Random();

    @Inject
    public ShopLogic(@NotNull uSkyBlock plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
        this.logger = plugin.getLogger();
        this.config = FileUtil.getYmlConfiguration("shop.yml");
        loadConfig();
        scheduleRandomShopRefresh();
    }

    private void loadConfig() {
        categories.clear();
        this.priceIncreasePercent = config.getDouble("price-increase.increase-percent", 25);
        this.resetMinutes = config.getLong("price-increase.reset-minutes", 60);

        ConfigurationSection catSection = config.getConfigurationSection("categories");
        if (catSection == null) return;

        for (String catId : catSection.getKeys(false)) {
            ConfigurationSection cat = catSection.getConfigurationSection(catId);
            if (cat == null) continue;

            String name = cat.getString("name", catId);
            ItemStack displayItem = ItemStackUtil.createItemStack(cat.getString("displayItem", "STONE"));

            List<ShopItem> items = new ArrayList<>();
            ConfigurationSection itemSection = cat.getConfigurationSection("items");
            if (itemSection != null) {
                for (String itemId : itemSection.getKeys(false)) {
                    ConfigurationSection item = itemSection.getConfigurationSection(itemId);
                    if (item == null) continue;

                    ItemStack itemDisplay = ItemStackUtil.createItemStack(
                        item.getString("displayItem", "STONE"));
                    String displayName = item.getString("displayName");
                    double cost = item.getDouble("cost", 10);
                    int maxBuys = item.getInt("max-buys", 64);
                    int requiredLevel = item.getInt("required-level", 0);
                    List<String> requiredChallenges = item.getStringList("required-challenges");

                    List<String> itemRewards = item.getStringList("items");
                    if (itemRewards.isEmpty() && item.getString("items") != null) {
                        itemRewards.addAll(Arrays.asList(item.getString("items").split(" ")));
                    }

                    List<String> commands = item.getStringList("commands");
                    if (commands.isEmpty() && item.getString("commands") != null) {
                        commands.add(item.getString("commands"));
                    }

                    String bundleName = item.getString("bundle.name");
                    List<String> bundleDesc = item.getStringList("bundle.description");

                    items.add(new ShopItem(itemId, itemDisplay, displayName, cost, maxBuys,
                        requiredLevel, requiredChallenges, itemRewards, commands,
                        bundleName, bundleDesc));
                }
            }
            categories.put(catId, new ShopCategory(catId, name, displayItem, items));
        }
    }

    // ==================== 文森商店 ====================

    private void scheduleRandomShopRefresh() {
        refreshRandomShop();

        long current = System.currentTimeMillis();
        Calendar cal = Calendar.getInstance();
        cal.set(Calendar.MINUTE, 0);
        cal.set(Calendar.SECOND, 0);
        cal.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);

        long delay = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        int[] hours = {6, 12, 18};
        for (int h : hours) {
            cal.set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, h);
            long time = cal.getTimeInMillis();
            if (time <= current) {
                time += 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
            }
            long d = time - current;
            if (d < delay) {
                delay = d;
            }
        }

        plugin.getScheduler().sync(() -> {
            refreshRandomShop();
            plugin.getScheduler().sync(this::refreshRandomShop, Duration.ofHours(6), Duration.ofHours(6));
        }, Duration.ofMillis(delay));
    }

    public void refreshRandomShop() {
        randomShopItems.clear();
        List<ShopItem> allItems = new ArrayList<>();
        for (ShopCategory cat : categories.values()) {
            allItems.addAll(cat.getItems());
        }
        if (allItems.isEmpty()) return;

        Collections.shuffle(allItems, random);
        int count = Math.min(45, allItems.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            randomShopItems.add(new RandomShopItem(allItems.get(i)));
        }

        for (PlayerShopData data : playerData.values()) {
            data.resetRandomShopBuys();
        }
        logger.info("文森商店已刷新，上架 " + randomShopItems.size() + " 件商品");
    }

    public List<RandomShopItem> getRandomShopItems() {
        return new ArrayList<>(randomShopItems);
    }

    public ShopCategory getRandomShopCategory() {
        return new ShopCategory(
            RANDOM_SHOP_CATEGORY_ID,
            "&d文森商店",
            new ItemStack(Material.EMERALD),
            Collections.emptyList()
        );
    }

    // ==================== 公共方法 ====================

    public List<ShopCategory> getCategories() {
        List<ShopCategory> cats = new ArrayList<>();
        cats.add(getRandomShopCategory());
        cats.addAll(categories.values());
        return cats;
    }

    public ShopCategory getCategory(String id) {
        if (RANDOM_SHOP_CATEGORY_ID.equals(id)) {
            return getRandomShopCategory();
        }
        return categories.get(id);
    }

    public PlayerShopData getPlayerData(UUID uuid) {
        PlayerShopData data = playerData.get(uuid);
        if (data == null) {
            PlayerInfo pi = plugin.getPlayerInfo(uuid);
            if (pi != null) {
                data = PlayerShopData.load(pi.getConfig().getConfigurationSection("shop"));
            } else {
                data = new PlayerShopData();
            }
            playerData.put(uuid, data);
        }
        data.resetIfNeeded(resetMinutes);
        return data;
    }

    public void savePlayerData(UUID uuid) {
        PlayerShopData data = playerData.get(uuid);
        if (data != null) {
            PlayerInfo pi = plugin.getPlayerInfo(uuid);
            if (pi != null) {
                data.save(pi.getConfig().createSection("shop"));
                pi.save();
            }
        }
    }

    public double getCurrentPrice(ShopItem item, UUID playerUuid) {
        PlayerShopData data = getPlayerData(playerUuid);
        int buyCount = data.getBuyCount(item.getId());
        double price = item.getBaseCost();
        for (int i = 0; i < buyCount; i++) {
            price *= (1 + priceIncreasePercent / 100.0);
        }
        return price;
    }

    public int getActualPrice(ShopItem item, UUID playerUuid) {
        return (int) Math.floor(getCurrentPrice(item, playerUuid));
    }

    public boolean canBuy(ShopItem item, UUID playerUuid) {
        PlayerShopData data = getPlayerData(playerUuid);
        return data.getBuyCount(item.getId()) < item.getMaxBuys();
    }

    public void reload() {
        FileUtil.reload();
        loadConfig();
        logger.info("ShopLogic: shop.yml reloaded. Loaded " + categories.size() + " categories.");
    }
}

public class PlayerShopData {

    private final Map<String, Long> lastBuyTime = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, Integer> randomShopBuys = new HashMap<>();
    private long lastResetTime = Instant.now().getEpochSecond();

    public int getBuyCount(String itemId) {
        return buyCounts.getOrDefault(itemId, 0);
    }

    public void incrementBuyCount(String itemId) {
        buyCounts.put(itemId, getBuyCount(itemId) + 1);
        lastBuyTime.put(itemId, Instant.now().getEpochSecond());
    }

    public long getLastBuyTime(String itemId) {
        return lastBuyTime.getOrDefault(itemId, Instant.EPOCH.getEpochSecond());
    }

    public long getLastResetTime() {
        return lastResetTime;
    }

    public void resetIfNeeded(long resetMinutes) {
        if (Instant.now().isAfter(Instant.ofEpochSecond(lastResetTime).plusSeconds(resetMinutes * 60))) {
            buyCounts.clear();
            lastBuyTime.clear();
            lastResetTime = Instant.now().getEpochSecond();
        }
    }

    // === 序列化到 YAML ===
    public void save(ConfigurationSection section) {
        section.set("lastResetTime", lastResetTime);
        for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> entry : buyCounts.entrySet()) {
            section.set("buyCounts." + entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
        }
    }

    // === 从 YAML 加载 ===
    public static PlayerShopData load(ConfigurationSection section) {
        PlayerShopData data = new PlayerShopData();
        if (section != null) {
            data.lastResetTime = section.getLong("lastResetTime", Instant.now().getEpochSecond());
            ConfigurationSection counts = section.getConfigurationSection("buyCounts");
            if (counts != null) {
                for (String key : counts.getKeys(false)) {
                    data.buyCounts.put(key, counts.getInt(key));
                }
            }
        }
        return data;
    }

java
package us.talabrek.ultimateskyblock.shop;

import org.bukkit.configuration.ConfigurationSection;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class PlayerShopData {
    private final Map<String, Integer> buyCounts = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, Long> lastBuyTime = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, Integer> randomShopBuys = new HashMap<>();
    private long lastResetTime = Instant.now().getEpochSecond();

    public int getBuyCount(String itemId) {
        return buyCounts.getOrDefault(itemId, 0);
    }

    public void incrementBuyCount(String itemId) {
        buyCounts.put(itemId, getBuyCount(itemId) + 1);
        lastBuyTime.put(itemId, Instant.now().getEpochSecond());
    }

    public long getLastBuyTime(String itemId) {
        return lastBuyTime.getOrDefault(itemId, Instant.EPOCH.getEpochSecond());
    }

    public long getLastResetTime() {
        return lastResetTime;
    }

    public void resetIfNeeded(long resetMinutes) {
        if (Instant.now().isAfter(Instant.ofEpochSecond(lastResetTime).plusSeconds(resetMinutes * 60))) {
            buyCounts.clear();
            lastBuyTime.clear();
            lastResetTime = Instant.now().getEpochSecond();
        }
    }

    // ==================== 文森商店 ====================

    public int getRandomShopBuyCount(String itemId) {
        return randomShopBuys.getOrDefault(itemId, 0);
    }

    public void incrementRandomShopBuyCount(String itemId) {
        randomShopBuys.put(itemId, getRandomShopBuyCount(itemId) + 1);
    }

    public void resetRandomShopBuys() {
        randomShopBuys.clear();
    }

    // ==================== 序列化 ====================

    public void save(ConfigurationSection section) {
        section.set("lastResetTime", lastResetTime);
        for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> entry : buyCounts.entrySet()) {
            section.set("buyCounts." + entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
        }
        // 保存文森购买次数
        for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> entry : randomShopBuys.entrySet()) {
            section.set("randomShopBuys." + entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
        }
    }

    public static PlayerShopData load(ConfigurationSection section) {
        PlayerShopData data = new PlayerShopData();
        if (section != null) {
            data.lastResetTime = section.getLong("lastResetTime", Instant.now().getEpochSecond());
            ConfigurationSection counts = section.getConfigurationSection("buyCounts");
            if (counts != null) {
                for (String key : counts.getKeys(false)) {
                    data.buyCounts.put(key, counts.getInt(key));
                }
            }
            // 加载文森购买次数
            ConfigurationSection randomCounts = section.getConfigurationSection("randomShopBuys");
            if (randomCounts != null) {
                for (String key : randomCounts.getKeys(false)) {
                    data.randomShopBuys.put(key, randomCounts.getInt(key));
                }
            }
        }
        return data;
    }
}

    public Inventory displayPartyPlayerGUI(final Player inventoryViewer, final PlayerProfile partyMember) {
        if (partyMember == null || partyMember.getName() == null || partyMember.getUniqueId() == null) {
            plugin.getLogger().warning("Invalid PlayerProfile passed to displayPartyPlayerGUI, returning to party menu.");
            return displayPartyGUI(inventoryViewer);
        }
        String name = partyMember.getName();
        List<String> lores = new ArrayList<>();
        String emptyTitle = tr("{0} <{1}>", "", tr("Permissions"));
        String title = tr("{0} <{1}>", name.substring(0, Math.min(32 - emptyTitle.length(), name.length())), tr("Permissions"));
        Inventory menu = Bukkit.createInventory(new UltimateHolder(inventoryViewer, title, MenuType.DEFAULT), 9, title);
        final ItemStack pHead = new ItemStack(Material.PLAYER_HEAD, 1);
        final SkullMeta meta3 = requireNonNull((SkullMeta) requireNonNull(pHead.getItemMeta()));
        ItemMeta meta2 = requireNonNull(requireNonNull(sign.getItemMeta()));
        meta2.setDisplayName(tr("\u00a79Player Permissions"));
        addLore(lores, tr("\u00a7eClick here to return to\n\u00a7eyour island group''s info."));
        meta2.setLore(lores);
        sign.setItemMeta(meta2);
        menu.addItem(sign);
        lores.clear();
        meta3.setOwnerProfile(partyMember);
        meta3.setDisplayName(tr("\u00a7e{0}''\u00a79s Permissions", name));
        addLore(lores, tr("\u00a7eHover over an icon to view\n\u00a7ea permission. Change the\n\u00a7epermission by clicking it."));
        meta3.setLore(lores);
        pHead.setItemMeta(meta3);
        menu.addItem(pHead);
        lores.clear();
        IslandInfo islandInfo = plugin.getIslandInfo(inventoryViewer);
        boolean isLeader = islandInfo.isLeader(inventoryViewer);
        for (PartyPermissionMenuItem menuItem : permissionMenuItems) {
            ItemStack itemStack = menuItem.getIcon();
            meta2 = requireNonNull(requireNonNull(itemStack.getItemMeta()));
            if (islandInfo.hasPerm(partyMember.getUniqueId(), menuItem.getPerm())) {
                meta2.setDisplayName("\u00a7a" + menuItem.getTitle());
                lores.add(tr("\u00a7fThis player \u00a7acan"));
                addLore(lores, "\u00a7f", menuItem.getDescription());
                if (isLeader) {
                    addLore(lores, "\u00a7f", tr("Click here to remove this permission."));
                }
            } else {
                meta2.setDisplayName("\u00a7c" + menuItem.getTitle());
                lores.add(tr("\u00a7fThis player \u00a7ccannot"));
                addLore(lores, "\u00a7f", menuItem.getDescription());
                if (isLeader) {
                    addLore(lores, "\u00a7f", tr("Click here to grant this permission."));
                }
            }
            meta2.setLore(lores);
            itemStack.setItemMeta(meta2);
            menu.addItem(itemStack);
            lores.clear();
        }
        return menu;
    }

    private void addLore(List<String> lores, String format, String multiLine) {

        }
    }

    public Inventory displayPartyGUI(final Player player) {
        List<String> lores = new ArrayList<>();
        String title = "\u00a79" + tr("Island Group Members");
        Inventory menu = Bukkit.createInventory(new UltimateHolder(player, title, MenuType.DEFAULT), 18, title);
        IslandInfo islandInfo = plugin.getIslandInfo(player);
        final Set<UUID> memberList = islandInfo.getMemberUUIDs();
        final ItemMeta meta2 = requireNonNull(requireNonNull(sign.getItemMeta()));
        meta2.setDisplayName("\u00a7a" + tr("Island Group Members"));
        lores.add(tr("Group Members: \u00a72{0}\u00a77/\u00a7e{1}", islandInfo.getPartySize(), islandInfo.getMaxPartySize()));
        if (islandInfo.getPartySize() < islandInfo.getMaxPartySize()) {
            addLore(lores, tr("\u00a7aMore players can be invited to this island."));
        } else {
            addLore(lores, tr("\u00a7cThis island is full."));
        }
        addLore(lores, tr("\u00a7eHover over a player''s icon to\n\u00a7eview their permissions. The\n\u00a7eleader can change permissions\n\u00a7eby clicking a player''s icon."));
        meta2.setLore(lores);
        sign.setItemMeta(meta2);
        menu.addItem(sign.clone());
        lores.clear();
        for (UUID memberId : memberList) {
            ItemStack headItem = new ItemStack(Material.PLAYER_HEAD, 1);
            SkullMeta meta3 = requireNonNull((SkullMeta) requireNonNull(headItem.getItemMeta()));
            // ★★★ 获取玩家名字，用于显示和创建完整的 PlayerProfile ★★★
            String memberName = Bukkit.getOfflinePlayer(memberId).getName();
            if (memberName == null) {
                memberName = memberId.toString();
            }
            meta3.setDisplayName(tr("\u00a7e{0}''s\u00a79 Permissions", memberName));
            // ★★★ 用完整信息创建 PlayerProfile，避免 getName() 返回 null ★★★
            meta3.setOwnerProfile(Bukkit.createPlayerProfile(memberId, memberName));
            boolean isLeader = islandInfo.isLeader(memberId);
            if (isLeader) {
                addLore(lores, "\u00a7a\u00a7l", tr("Leader"));
            } else {
                addLore(lores, "\u00a7e\u00a7l", tr("Member"));
            }
            for (PartyPermissionMenuItem perm : permissionMenuItems) {
                if (isLeader || islandInfo.hasPerm(memberId, perm.getPerm())) {
                    lores.add("\u00a7a" + tr("Can {0}", "\u00a7f" + perm.getShortDescription()));
                } else {
                    lores.add("\u00a7c" + tr("Cannot {0}", "\u00a7f" + perm.getShortDescription()));
                }
            }
            if (islandInfo.isLeader(player.getName())) {
                addLore(lores, tr("\u00a7e<Click to change this player''s permissions>"));
            }
            meta3.setLore(lores);
            headItem.setItemMeta(meta3);
            menu.addItem(headItem);
            lores.clear();
        }
        return menu;
    }

    public Inventory displayLogGUI(final Player player) {
